objective.text: Retain the paginated data envelope even when ordinary resource wrapping is disabled.

difficulty.rationale: Recognize the pagination envelope exception to ordinary unwrapped resources.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: JsonResource::withoutWrapping() is enabled. A resource collection wraps a LengthAwarePaginator. What shape should a client still expect?

options.text: A data envelope with pagination links and meta.
options.rationale: Paginated resource responses retain data wrapping to accompany the pagination information.

options.text: An exception because pagination requires the global wrap setting to remain enabled.
options.rationale: The resource machinery handles pagination wrapping even when ordinary wrapping is disabled.
options.misconception: The resource machinery handles pagination wrapping even when ordinary wrapping is disabled.

options.text: Only pagination links, because items require wrapping to serialize.
options.rationale: The items still serialize inside the paginated response.
options.misconception: The items still serialize inside the paginated response.

options.text: Only the bare item array with no links or meta.
options.rationale: Disabling ordinary wrapping does not remove the pagination response structure.
options.misconception: Disabling ordinary wrapping does not remove the pagination response structure.
